name: AWPS Series Plate-Shell Heat Exchanger - I
full_description: The AWPS Series Plate-Shell Heat Exchanger - I is designed for high-temperature and high-pressure industrial applications. Accessen describes it as combining the heat transfer characteristics of gasketed plate exchangers with the pressure and temperature resistance associated with shell-and-tube equipment, while retaining a removable structure for cleaning.
advantage: Retains heat transfer characteristics of gasketed exchangers
Removable for cleaning with no gasket aging

details.title: How does AWPS differ from conventional shell-and-tube equipment?
details.content: Accessen positions AWPS as a high-efficiency alternative that combines plate-type heat transfer performance with stronger pressure and temperature resistance, helping replace shell-and-tube exchangers in demanding industrial service.

details.title: What maintenance benefit is highlighted?
details.content: The product is described as removable for cleaning and avoids gasket aging, which helps lower operating costs over time.
